content.text: For observability, I recommend choosing Datadog over New Relic. Datadog already supports our Kubernetes metrics and the Terraform module is ready.

provenance.quote: For observability, I recommend choosing Datadog over New Relic. Datadog already supports our Kubernetes metrics and the Terraform module is ready.

message.text: For observability, I recommend choosing Datadog over New Relic. Datadog already supports our Kubernetes metrics and the Terraform module is ready.

content.text: New Relic is cheaper by about 18%, but the migration would take longer because we need to rebuild several dashboards. The tradeoff with Datadog is higher monthly spend.

content.text: I'm concerned about locking into another expensive vendor, but the outage review showed we need better Kubernetes alerts before the enterprise SLA starts on 2026-07-15.
